name: mega-cloud-mcp
description: Operate your MEGA cloud account (list, search, upload, download, share) via MEGAcmd.
long_description: Wraps the MEGAcmd CLI so an AI assistant can manage files in your end-to-end encrypted MEGA account. You log in out-of-band yourself in the MEGAcmd interactive shell (login <email>); no credentials ever pass through the AI. Destructive and data-moving actions require explicit confirmation.

tools.name: megacmd_setup
tools.description: Download + verify the MEGAcmd engine on first use (no login).

tools.name: mega_whoami
tools.description: Show the logged-in MEGA account (email only).

tools.name: mega_account
tools.description: Show the account plan tier and storage (no session/balance).

tools.name: mega_logout
tools.description: Log out of the current MEGA session (confirm).

tools.name: mega_find
tools.description: Search cloud files by name pattern.

tools.name: mega_tree
tools.description: Show a cloud folder as an indented tree.

tools.name: mega_du
tools.description: Report storage used by a cloud path.

tools.name: mega_mount
tools.description: List account roots and incoming shares.

tools.name: mega_attr_set
tools.description: Set or delete a node attribute (confirm).

tools.name: mega_errorcode
tools.description: Explain a numeric MEGAcmd error code.

tools.name: mega_config
tools.description: Show or change a MEGAcmd setting (set: confirm).

tools.name: mega_mv
tools.description: Move or rename a cloud node (confirm).

tools.name: mega_put
tools.description: Upload a local file/folder to the cloud (confirm).

tools.name: mega_share
tools.description: Share a folder with a user, revoke, or list shares (add/remove confirm).

tools.name: mega_import
tools.description: Import a public link (incl. password-protected) into the account (confirm).

tools.name: mega_userattr_set
tools.description: Set one of your own profile attributes (confirm).

tools.name: mega_showpcr
tools.description: Show pending contact requests (opt-in; surfaces contact PII).

tools.name: mega_sessions
tools.description: List active login sessions (opt-in; surfaces login PII).

tools.name: mega_balance
tools.description: Show balance and payment history (opt-in; surfaces financial PII).

tools.name: mega_cat
tools.description: Read a file's text contents, capped (opt-in; brings file content into context).

megacmd_dir.title: MEGAcmd install directory (optional)
megacmd_dir.description: Only set this if MEGAcmd is not bundled or not on PATH. Point to the folder containing mega-ls, mega-whoami, etc.

max_list_lines.title: Max listing lines returned
max_list_lines.description: Cap on rows returned by ls/find to keep responses small.

expose_contacts.title: Expose contact tools
expose_contacts.description: Enable mega_users / mega_showpcr / mega_userattr. Off by default: these surface contact emails/names (third-party PII) into the conversation.

expose_account_details.title: Expose account-detail tools
expose_account_details.description: Enable mega_sessions / mega_balance. Off by default: these surface your own login metadata (IP/location/devices) and financial history into the conversation.

expose_file_contents.title: Enable reading file contents
expose_file_contents.description: Enable mega_cat so an AI assistant can read the text contents of your cloud files (for content-based search). Off by default: it brings cloud file content (capped, text-only) into the conversation.
